children: Prices range from Rs 20,990 to Rs 30,990; exports of the new AX series are scheduled to begin in 2027, targeting over 10 countries worldwide

LG Electronics India introduces its latest range of semi-automatic washing machines, bringing together powerful performance, smart convenience and bold design. The new lineup consists of 15 models ranging from 8 to 12-kilogram capacities, offering Indian households greater choice across family sizes and laundry needs. Exports of the new AX series are scheduled to begin in 2027, targeting over 10 countries worldwide.

The range introduces several innovations aimed at tackling everyday laundry challenges such as detergent residue, lint, stubborn stains, slow drying and fragile lids. At the core of the lineup is the Dual Spin Shower, which uses two powerful water inlets to rinse away detergent more effectively. The Roller Jet Pulsator+, inspired by whale-tail design, enhances water circulation to remove dirt while protecting fabrics.

The Ultra Scrub Wall is designed to handle tough dirt on collars and cuffs, while the Smart Filter captures lint efficiently for improved wash quality. Wind Jet Dry+ accelerates drying by using powerful airflow during spinning, and the machines also feature 3+1 wash programs and Rat Away Technology for added durability.

Design has been a key focus, with the new models featuring a strong box-type body, bold patterns, durable knobs and premium colour options such as Onyx Black, Middle Black and Burgundy. Select models include a Toughened Glass Lid with a soft-closing mechanism, offering enhanced durability and quieter operation.

Manufactured at LG’s Greater Noida facility, the machines benefit from Industry 5.0-centric smart factory operations, including AI-enabled production, robotics and automation. Reliability is ensured through 100 per cent quality checks, AI vision inspection and rigorous testing in NABL-accredited labs.

According to Young Min Hwang, Home Appliances Solution Sales Division Leader at LG Electronics India, the new range is designed for consumers who expect more from everyday laundry, combining trusted technology, durable engineering and premium design.
